title: Grand Duchy of Berg
capsule: The Grand Duchy of Berg was a Napoleonic client state created in March 1806 when Napoleon awarded the Duchy of Berg and Cleves to his brother-in-law Joachim Murat, following the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire after Austerlitz. In 1808 Murat departed to become King of Naples and Napoleon placed his infant nephew Louis Napoleon on the throne as a nominal ruler, governing Berg directly through French prefects who applied the Napoleonic Code. At its greatest extent the grand duchy encompassed the right-bank Rhine territories between Westphalia and the annexed French departments; it was dissolved in 1813 as French power collapsed after the Russian campaign, and the Congress of Vienna (1815) confirmed Prussian sovereignty over the region.
